# Query.TrimmedQuery property

Original query but with trimmed whitespace. Includes action keyword. It has handled built-in custom query hotkeys and build-in shortcuts. If you need the exact original query from the search box, use OriginalQuery property instead. We don't recommend using this property directly. You should always use Search property.
